analysis_name: Continuous Support, Applicability Domain and Selective Prediction

support_scores.chemical_support_percentile: Outer-training empirical percentile of test maximum Morgan-r2 Tanimoto against training-parent leave-one-out NN Tanimoto distribution; higher = more supported.
support_scores.biological_support_percentile: 1 minus outer-training empirical percentile of test median HTTr 5NN PCA distance against training-parent leave-one-out HTTr-distance distribution; higher = more supported.
support_scores.joint_support_sensitivity: Minimum of chemical and biological support percentiles; stored but not a primary selective-ranking strategy.

continuous_reliability_model.predictors: z chemical novelty + z biological novelty + their interaction + z model uncertainty
continuous_reliability_model.purpose: Test whether chemical and biological support contribute information about probability error beyond maximum-class-probability confidence.
continuous_reliability_model.incremental_information: Delta R2 of full support+uncertainty model versus uncertainty-only model; descriptive with bootstrap CI.

selective_prediction.primary_scope: all immutable OOF parents for each endpoint
selective_prediction.hybrid_score: geometric mean of joint support and confidence score
selective_prediction.aurc_range: coverage 0.50 to 1.00 in 0.01 increments; normalized trapezoidal area, lower = better
primary_comparisons: full-risk minus JOINT_SUPPORT AURC (positive = selective benefit)
full-risk minus HYBRID_SUPPORT_CONFIDENCE AURC (positive = selective benefit)
CONFIDENCE AURC minus JOINT_SUPPORT AURC (positive = support better than confidence)
CONFIDENCE AURC minus HYBRID_SUPPORT_CONFIDENCE AURC (positive = hybrid better than confidence)

inference.p_value: centered two-sided bootstrap for signed effects
inference.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR within named coefficient/comparison families
inference.across_endpoint_synthesis: DerSimonian-Laird style random-effects using endpoint bootstrap SE; endpoint effects remain visible
